name: Analysis tab is visible on a match detail page
description: When a visitor opens a match detail page, an Analysis tab or section control is present and visible without requiring scroll, enabling navigation to the match analysis content.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage at the root URL
Click on any bracket cell or fixture link to open a match detail page
Wait for the match detail page to fully render
Verify that a tab, button, or section control labeled 'Analysis', 'Match Analysis', or a similar label is visible in the match detail page header or tab bar without requiring additional scroll
